protocol.observer: simulation truth; no real sensor/vehicle validation
protocol.world: independent horizontal Bullet plane; gravity -9.81; no window
protocol.comparison: same mode core car, initial conditions and commands; only three load exponents differ
protocol.candidate_B: current mode config exponents; full configs retained
protocol.initialization: one assignment of speed/pure rolling; airborne +2m or coast yaw +.5rad/s only at initialization; no runtime state edits
protocol.constant_turn: 40 km/h; steering 3 degrees, throttle .15 fixed; no imposed radius
protocol.force_feedback: full normal_load, force_grip, force_longitudinal_stiffness and force_lateral_stiffness per wheel retained; force_contact_tick distinguishes force from completed sample
protocol.tire_contact_moment: pre-force pose and previous contacts; matched force_contact_tick; Fx/Fy last substep and cumulative impulse/dt mean at sampled fixed contact; body-up projection; excludes axle reactions and other torques, not net body moment
protocol.scope: all raw outcomes and deltas retained; no mandatory distance/yaw improvement or high fidelity acceptance
